name: Kor'ghan
summary: In Orgrimmar’s Cleft of Shadow, Kor'ghan watches over remedies and toxins. The Darkspear troll stands outside Rekkul's Poisons and seeks help preparing antidotes for Durotar’s venomous predators.

sections.title: A Troll in the Shadows
sections.body: Kor'ghan keeps watch over remedies and toxins outside Rekkul's Poisons in Orgrimmar’s Cleft of Shadow. From the capital, he sends travelers into Durotar’s red canyons to gather venomous components from scorpids. He needs them to prepare antidotes for the dangers of the wilderness.

faq.answer: Kor'ghan is a Darkspear troll who stands outside Rekkul's poison shop in Orgrimmar’s Cleft of Shadow.
Find Kor'ghan in the Cleft of Shadow beneath central Orgrimmar, directly in front of Rekkul's Poisons.

faq.q: What does Kor'ghan need help with?
faq.answer: Kor'ghan needs travelers to gather poison sacs from venomtail scorpids near Orgrimmar’s entrance so he can formulate antidotes.

faq.q: Was Kor'ghan ever found in Durotar?
faq.answer: Kor'ghan stays near the poison suppliers in Orgrimmar. He sends travelers into Durotar to gather poison sacs from venomtail scorpids near the city’s entrance.

angles.text: As a rogue, you may see Kor'ghan outside Rekkul's Poisons in the Cleft of Shadow while visiting Orgrimmar’s underbelly for reagents and venoms.
As a troll, you share kinship with many Darkspear who have left Sen'jin Village. Kor'ghan puts his knowledge of Durotar’s wild hazards to use in the Horde’s fortified capital.
